This internship is designed to give a high-potential student meaningful, hands-on exposure to how transformation and AI initiatives are identified, shaped, delivered, and adopted within a large enterprise environment. The role sits within the Transformation & Agile team and supports real work across AI adoption, change enablement, continuous improvement, and value tracking. Rather than acting as general support, the intern will contribute to defined initiatives, produce tangible outputs, and learn how technology and AI are translated into practical business outcomes.

The role is particularly suited to a student who is curious about how AI moves from idea to impact, including how opportunities are identified, how teams align around them, how adoption is encouraged, and how results are communicated to stakeholders.

2. Learning Objectives & Development Focus
By the end of the internship, the intern should have developed a practical understanding of how transformation and AI work happens in an enterprise environment. This includes exposure to how opportunities are identified, how teams collaborate across functions, how change is supported, and how value is tracked and communicated.
Expected learning outcomes include:

Understanding how Transformation, Agile, Digital, and business teams work together to deliver meaningful change.
Building practical skills in structured problem analysis, synthesis, documentation, and presentation of insights.
Developing exposure to AI adoption activities, including enablement materials, communications, simple measurement, and feedback gathering.
Learning how to support workshops, working sessions, and stakeholder discussions in a way that creates clarity and momentum.
Strengthening professional capabilities such as communication, ownership, collaboration, and business-oriented thinking.

3. Key Responsibilities
The intern will contribute to a selected set of real initiatives. Exact focus may vary based on team priorities, but work will typically include 3–5 of the areas below:
AI Opportunity & Problem Discovery

Support the team in analysing business problems, pain points, or opportunities where AI or better ways of working may create value.
Help organize findings into simple, clear summaries that compare current challenges, possible approaches, and expected benefits.
AI Adoption & Enablement
Assist in preparing practical materials that support AI adoption, such as summaries, communication content, demo narratives, or simple usage insights.
Support activities that help colleagues understand how AI tools can be used responsibly and effectively in day-to-day work.
Transformation & Change Support
Contribute to workshops, showcases, and working sessions by helping prepare materials, capture insights, and follow up on actions.
Support simple change and engagement activities that help teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and what success looks like.
Insights, Tracking & Storytelling
Prepare concise dashboards, summaries, or presentation materials that communicate initiative progress, adoption signals, or key learnings.
Help turn complex or scattered information into clear messages for leadership or team use.
Research & Continuous Improvement
Conduct light research on emerging AI tools, external practices, or internal learnings and bring back relevant insights for discussion.
Identify patterns or improvement opportunities in how work is organized, communicated, or tracked.


4. Exposure & Team Environment
The intern will work within the Transformation & Agile team and will have opportunities to engage with colleagues across Digital, Technology, business, and change-oriented roles. Depending on the work assigned, the intern may interact with agile coaches, portfolio stakeholders, regional office stakeholder, and team members involved in AI or transformation initiatives.
The internship will include regular guidance, practical feedback, and coaching. The intern will not be expected to operate independently without support; instead, the role is designed to combine structured supervision with enough ownership to create real development and confidence.

We are looking for a student who shows strong learning agility, curiosity, and ownership potential. Ideal candidates are likely to demonstrate the following:

Currently pursuing a degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Data, Engineering, Design, Psychology, Communications, or a related field.
Strong interest in AI, digital innovation, transformation, or how organizations improve the way work gets done.

Exposure to tools or concepts such as M365 Copilot, automation, data analysis, process improvement, or AI-related tools is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.

6. Internship Structure & Commitment
This is a full-time internship running from June to August. The intern is expected to commit to the full internship period and actively participate in project work, team activities, and learning opportunities. The role is designed to provide meaningful contribution and development, with clear guidance and practical exposure throughout the program.

7. What the Intern Will Gain

Hands-on exposure to real transformation and AI-related initiatives in a professional enterprise environment.
Experience turning ideas, observations, and scattered information into structured outputs that support decision making.
Mentorship and feedback from experienced practitioners involved in transformation, change, and digital delivery.
A stronger foundation for future careers in technology, digital, consulting, product, transformation, or innovation-related roles.

JobTitle: Agency Lending Trader - Financing Solutions, Assistant Vice President
FullText:
Who we are

State Street’s Financing Solutions (FS) division is comprised of three distinct business lines: Agency Lending, Prime Services and Secured Financing.

Agency Lending is our traditional and long-established business line involved in physical Stock Borrow and Lending; with a substantial global footprint and deep market connectivity State Street is considered an industry leader in the space. Agency Lending helps to generate liquidity for global financial markets and earn additional yield for clients. Clients lend their underutilized securities via the Agency program to a borrower against collateral for a fee. Prime Services is a form of Principal Lending and is a more recent addition to the product line; Prime offers unique custodial services to clients helping them improve their counterparty risk profile whilst adding efficient solutions that support their financing needs. The relatively new Secured Financing component of the division connects a wide range of market participants to funding solutions via peer-to-peer proprietary and industry platforms. Secured Financing has been the fastest growth area of the division in recent years and reflects strong momentum of demand for dollar financing solutions in a high rate environment.

The Financing Solutions team is eager to meet enthusiastic, energetic and ambitious individuals, passionate about markets and data analytics. With a strong commitment to diversity, we are eager to speak with people from a variety of backgrounds that may or may not have direct financial experience but exhibit strong data skills, possess varying sales and relationship experience, or have an interesting work history.

Who we are looking for

The Agency Lending Trading Team is seeking to expand its footprint with an opportunity at ‘Assistant Vice President’ level based in Hong Kong. This is the opportunity to be part of a small specialized and experienced trading team right at the forefront of frontier growth markets, working together to build stronger outcomes for our clients; there are significant opportunities to work with deep datasets to extrapolate value, working closely with our low touch systematic trading team. Possessing a strong character is helpful for being effective in this role, as is a history of teamwork whether in sport or in a work environment. Consideration will be made to those who express a strong interest in global Fixed Income and Equity Markets, and those confident enough to take a view on something and be comfortable enough questioning the status quo.

Your job as an Agency Lending Trader will be to learn the ropes quickly, assuming a role as a contributor to the bottom line; you will be expected to build your career and develop a network within the Securities Finance market and within the firm; you will be expected to act consistently and conscientiously, with the best interests of our clients in mind, to trade their assets in an efficient, effective and profitable manner. State Street takes its position as a safe keeper of assets very seriously and trust is a mainstay of our organization; all team members are expected to comply with a myriad of internal and external rules and regulations which serve to protect our clients and the institution; diligence and maturity is critical in this regard.

You will be exposed to a great mix of technology, innovation, operations, sales, trading, marketing, strategy, and relationship management. Support will come from on the job training, along with regular catch up sessions with your manager; there will be some latitude in the role, if you are hungry by nature and a self-starter, you will likely excel.

What you will be responsible for

As Agency Lending Trader, you will

Negotiate stock volumes and borrowing levels efficiently and profitably

Monitor, check and respond to all relevant indications of interest and reply in a prompt and expedient manner

Attempt to ascertain the reason for borrow demand e.g. CBs, Pairs, Shorts

Thoroughly check inventory for possible revenue opportunities

Summarise daily trade flow to your peers in our global trading locations

Apply and adjust any relevant rate changes onto outstanding and future borrows

Facilitate all pending or failing settlement issues by liaising with the appropriate operations personnel and counterparties ensuring all endeavours are made in order to settle trades

Conduct regular meetings with counterparties to discuss concerns, progress against goals, new trade or product opportunities etc.

Engage clients regularly in order to enhance goodwill and strengthen relationships

Continually seek improvements in all areas of trading and other associated areas.

5 days a week in-office based role

Market conditions can dictate alterations to daily scheduling

General trading hours span from 7am-5pm

These skills will help you succeed in this role

Exhibit a desire and passion to learn

Exceptionally strong communication skills and outgoing nature

Demonstrate strong analytical skills

Ability to work well under pressure and in a team environment

Capable of lateral thinking when solving problems

A friendly, confident, persistent, yet assertive demeanor.

Degree level (BA, BSc or international equivalent)

Bi or Multi-lingual ability will be beneficial and pertinent to the role

Securities & Futures Commission (Hong Kong) registered Type 1 (Dealing in Securities

Sound knowledge and understanding of Equity Finance, particularly within the field of SBL

Technology compliance, licensing, governance setup, massive data storage and related privacy security, virtual asset management, and resilience of the business as usual require heavy technology risk measures safeguard the crown jewels as well as complying to the requirement of the regulators. At EY, you will belong to an international connected team of specialists helping our clients with their most complex information security needs and contributing toward their business resilience. In simple terms, you know how to use your deep technical experience and apply that to a business where we need to battle risk and agility in the financial sector.

Your key responsibilities
EY consultants are considered by our clients as experts and trusted in what they do. Our technology risk teams focus on providing our consulting services which include:
Conduct technology compliance review for institutions in the banking, wealth and asset management and insurance sectors licensed under Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area and other regions.
Analyse client IT environment, identify risks and evaluate controls, including cloud security aspects in accordance with regulatory requirements and industry standards and best practice
Act as enabler with clients that desire to move towards compliance status, especially under controls and requirements from the local and regional Regulators
Act as a licensing advisor to help clients in financial activity licensing journey from technology risk perspective incooperation with the other EY teams
Assess and implement information security management frameworks based on well-known industry standards (e.g. ISO, NIST, COBIT, SANS)
Assist the clients to build a holistic governance and incident management framework to effectively respond to and recover from cyber incidents
Assess and advise on managing risk from emerging technologies such as blockchain, virtual assets, artificial intelligence/machine learning, big data, etc.
Develop and review information security strategy plans in alignment with business requirements using risk-based approach
Perform information security awareness training and training program development for clients
Conduct vulnerability scanning, penetration test and cyber-attack simulation to assess and improve the effectiveness of controls in place
Manage client expectations and program implementation plans attending stakeholders` needs using project management principles
Keep up-to-date with the latest security trends and also applicable privacy laws that could have an impact on clients
Contributing to the development of the existing technology risk team acting as mentor and coach to the junior members of the team and leading by example
Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication
Contributing to the creation of proposals and go-to-market material

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or masters’ degree preferably in one of the following areas: Information Security, Business Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, and other related majors
Relevant working experience (Less experience will be considered as junior grades) with hands-on experience on key components of the above-mentioned areas
Possession of the following certifications (not limited to): CISA, CISM, CISSP
Working towards the following technical certifications (not limited to): CRTP, CRTE, OSCP,GPEN, GXPN, Cloud-related certifications
Good computer skills - Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Chinese processing
Excellent written and spoken English and Chinese. Fluency in Mandarin is an advantage

Skills and attributes for success
A Big 4 background or comparable consulting experience is advantageous, although some of our strongest performers come directly from industry therefore candidates with excellent industry experience and demonstrable success managing transformation workstreams and proven experience of conducting cyber discussions at senior management are also encouraged to apply;
A broad background across security is expected with specific experience in 1 or more of the following areas essential;
Experience in managing and supervising teams of professional employees and mentoring team members through development feedback and performance processes
Experience in project management, preparing and providing high quality reports, and giving presentations to clients
Logical thinker with strong interpersonal and organizational skills. Able to interact effectively with both management and clients
Supervising, coaching, developing and leading teams and individual team members.


What we look for
Highly motivated, a good communicator you will need to convey technical content in business language with senior management. You will also need to be a team player who is not only looking to enhance their own career, but recognize the value in developing others and strengthening the team.


What working at EY offers
We offer a competitive compensation package where you will be rewarded based on your performance and recognised for the value you bring to the business. We also offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you

Research Assistant Professor

About the Centre
Hong Kong Catastrophic Risk Centre (HKCRC) was established in January 2022 as a research centre within the Department of Philosophy at Lingnan University, one of Asia's best in analytic philosophy. The department has a thriving research environment and already hosts several Postdoctoral Fellows/Research Assistant Professors. Faculty members publish in leading journals, such as Analysis, Australasian Journal of Philosophy, British Journal for the Philosophy of Science, Ethics, Journal of Philosophical Logic, Mind, Noûs, Philosophers’ Imprint, Philosophical Quarterly, Philosophical Studies, Philosophy and Phenomenological Research, and Philosophy of Science.

More information on the research centre can be found at: https://www.ln.edu.hk/philoso/hkcrc More information on the interests and publications of philosophers at Lingnan University can be found at: https://www.LN.edu.hk/philoso/?page_id=9.

Requirements
The Centre seeks to appoint a Research Assistant Professor with expertise in philosophy of AI (broadly understood) and/or ethics of risk. Candidates should have obtained / been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification for no more than five years prior to the commencement of the appointment, and a record of publications in Philosophy, preferably in leading journals. A technical background in AI—such as knowledge of machine learning or neural networks—will be an advantage.

The appointee is expected to conduct focused research, publish scholarly outputs in reputable, peer-reviewed international philosophical journals, and apply for competitive peer-reviewed grants offered by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council, as well as other local/overseas competitive grants and/or fellowship schemes. Teaching experience at undergraduate and/or taught master’s programme levels is a definite advantage.

Research: The Research Assistant Professor will (i) conduct research and submit papers to top philosophy journals (e.g., including 3*/4*-ranked journals per the current departmental journal list), (ii) submit grant proposals to various funding bodies, and (iii) organise seminars, reading groups, workshops, or other related research activities.

ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW

Apparel Impact Institute (Aii) identifies, funds and measures proven quality solutions to accelerate positive impact in the apparel and footwear industry. Aii programs focus on areas that result in positive environmental impact from the production of apparel and footwear products to improve the industry. Our current strategic focus in climate action is helping the industry reach their Science Based Targets commitment.

To date, Aii's flagship Clean By Design programs have removed over 1 million tonnes of carbon emissions from the supply chain and unlocked over $70M in sustainable finance for factory improvements, (e.g. water stewardship, chemical management and energy efficiency). Our work has been recognized in Vogue, Business of Fashion, Forbes and many other globally recognized publications. We are a fast-paced, entrepreneurial organization in growth-mode.

The Regional Lead for China and Greater China is responsible for brand engagement, as well as managing Aii's recruitment and ongoing partnership activities. This includes working with global retail brands, manufacturers, and service providers throughout the region. They will support the development and maintenance of a portfolio of projects, strategies, and tools designed to help industry partners reach their environmental impact goals.

To deliver intended outcomes for partnership engagement, program development, and fundraising, the Lead will work in close collaboration with both the Industry Engagement and Programs teams.

This role will ensure strong alignment between Aii's China-based team and global operations by addressing both operational consistency and cultural integration. Support strategic stakeholder engagement in China by representing Aii within Chinese industry groups, fostering connections with local partners, manufacturers, and NGOs
Work with our communications team to manage Aii's local communications strategy in China, continuously adapting and communicating Aii's mission and initiatives in a way that resonates with Chinese stakeholders, ensuring alignment with local values and perspectives
Create ongoing media and storytelling opportunities to illuminate leadership and drive greater industry and consumer engagement
Create a programs engagement and enrollment strategy for the Chinese market
Manage a portfolio of relationships, projects, and annual plans with brands and China based manufacturers
Bridge China team with our larger global operations, facilitating cross-collaboration across the organization through regular communication and initiatives

CompanyName: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
FullText:
Job Posting Details



The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) established the Division of Arts ad Machine Creativity (AMC) in July 2024 under the Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies (AIS), the fifth school of HKUST. As an interdisciplinary academic unit, AMC aims to be a leading center where technology, art, and humanities converge to drive creativity and innovation. We are seeking a high-caliber academic administrator to lead this new Division as the Founding Head.


The Role

Reporting to the Dean of AIS, the Founding Head will provide leadership and manage the Division's academic and administrative functions. Key responsibilities include advancing interdisciplinary teaching and research, faculty recruitment, and resource management. The Head will also develop strategies to promote the Division and facilitate interdisciplinary collaboration within HKUST and externally with arts organizations, as well as private, governmental, and non-governmental entities.


The Candidate

Applicants should be distinguished scholars or artists with outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishments, consistent with an appointment as Full Professor with tenure or equivalent. While a background in the arts is preferred, expertise in art technology and other related areas will be considered. Prior administrative experience is highly desirable. Candidates should demonstrate proven leadership, managerial capabilities, experience in leading collaborative programs, and success in securing external funding. The ability to engage effectively with arts organizations, government, industry, and commercial sectors is advantageous.


The Division

The Division of Arts and Machine Creativity (AMC) is an interdisciplinary academic unit envisioned as a pioneering center where technology, art, and humanities drive creativity and innovation. This initiative fosters a fusion of innovation and humanities, supporting HKUST’s Strategic Plan 2031 as a major effort to expand academic frontiers through, aiming to lead positive changes in education and research, and empower the next generation to address global challenges.


The mission of the Division includes:

Bridging the gap between technology and art, by providing students and researchers with professional education and robust environment.
Cultivating artistic and creative talents equipped with the skills and knowledge to leverage emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning.
Fostering a cross-disciplinary environment that empowers collaboration and innovation among artists and technologists.
Developing cutting-edge, interdisciplinary research and education programs in partnership with other institutions in the fields of arts and machine learning


AMC’s focus areas include: (a) digital art practice (including visual, sound, performing, installation, cinematic arts); (b) machine creativity; (c) art management covering managerial, legal, and business topics related to AI arts, NFT, etc.; and (d) critical studies examining art history, media theory, and philosophy of technology in the context of arts and machine creativity. The Division will offer graduate degree programs, including MA and MFA programs, as well as MPhil/PhD programs. It will also provide common core courses for all undergraduates at HKUST, and potentially undergraduate programs in future. The Division will collaborate with the Computational Media and Arts Thrust of HKUST(GZ) to advance scientific research in artificial intelligence in generative creativity and machine creativity.


The University

Founded in 1991, HKUST is a world-renowned international research university dedicated to the advancement of learning, research, scholarship, and the education of a new generation of elite students through top-tier programs in science, engineering, business & management, humanities & social science, and interdisciplinary studies.


HKUST is deeply committed to advancing humanities and arts education and research. The School of Humanities and Social Science offers diverse music and creative writing courses led by distinguished artists and active practitioners. Courses include “Music of the World”, “Introduction to Music Composition”, and “Chinese Creative Writing”, fostering creativity and collaboration. Additionally, film courses like “Independent Cinema in Contemporary China” are offered, broadening students' artistic perspectives.


Since it was founded 33 years ago, HKUST has already established a strong presence in global higher education and received a number of international recognitions. Among others, HKUST was ranked No.3 in the Times Higher Education’s Young University Rankings 2024, 12 of its subjects were ranked among the world’s top 50 in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2024. While the University is deeply rooted in Hong Kong, HKUST (GZ) in Guangzhou, Mainland China complements the well-established disciplinary foundation at the Hong Kong campus with 4 transdisciplinary hubs and 16 thrust areas. We are dedicated to educating well-rounded students with strong entrepreneurial spirits and innovative and globally oriented thinking. English is the medium of teaching, research, and administration at HKUST. HKUST promotes diversity with an inclusive and collaborative community and the use of modern instructional methods.


Terms & Applications

The appointment will be concurrent with a substantive professorial appointment. The headship will be a full-time appointment for an initial term of three years, and renewable for another term, subject to further review. HKUST provides competitive remuneration and generous fringe benefits, including housing where appropriate.


Application, including a curriculum vitae, a vision statement, as well as names and email addresses of at least three referees, should be sent to the AMC Head Search Committee (c/o Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies), the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Clearwater Bay, Kowloon, Hong Kong (or by email: amcdhsearch@ust.hk). Review of applications will begin from early December 2024 and continue until the position is filled.


For more information about the University, the Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies and the AMC Division, please visit https://hkust.edu.hk/ and https://ais.hkust.edu.hk/respectively.

Role Summary

At Bowtie, we aren’t just selling insurance; we’re rebuilding it from the ground up. As Hong Kong’s first virtual insurer, we thrive on transparency, efficiency, and data-driven decisions.


We are looking for a high-caliber Assistant Manager / Senior Associate to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team. This isn’t a role for "bean counters." We need a strategic storyteller who can sit at the intersection of Actuarial Science and Corporate Finance to help us navigate our next phase of hyper-growth.


About the Role

You will be working in a fast-paced organization that promotes cross-functional collaboration (objective of the role).

Your Key Responsibilities Include:


1. Performance Measurement & Reporting

Narrative-Driven Reporting: Own the monthly business review process, translating raw numbers into compelling narratives that explain "the why" behind Actuals vs. Plan.

LOB Precision: Execute granular Line of Business (LOB) reporting to provide the leadership team with visibility into specific margin contributions.

AI Integration: Partner with our Data Engineering teams to ensure financial data is "AI-ready," driving the transition toward automated variance reporting and predictive analytics.

2. Financial Management & Forecasting

Strategic Planning: Play a key role in the annual budgeting cycle, working cross-functionally with department heads to align resources with our mission.

Dynamic Modeling: Build and maintain rolling forecasts that are agile enough to reflect rapid business mix shifts and new product launches.

Liquidity Optimization: Monitor the Cash Conversion Cycle, identifying strategic levers to optimize liquidity while fueling our aggressive growth trajectory.

3. Business Optimization & Decision Support

Growth Feedback Loop: Conduct deep-dive Value vs. Cost analyses to provide actionable insights for our Marketing and Growth teams.

Scenario Modeling: Perform rigorous "What-If" stress testing (e.g., impact of sales volatility or regulatory changes) to manage stakeholder expectations and future-proof our strategy.

About you

We are looking for a unique blend of technical mastery and commercial curiosity. Whether you come from a traditional finance background or an actuarial path, you must be a builder at heart.
The Finance Path:

3–5 years of experience in FP&A or Corporate Finance within the insurance sector.

Expert-level understanding of P&L structures, cash flow management, and capital allocation.

The Actuarial Path:

3–5 years of experience in Actuarial Pricing or Valuations.

A strong desire to pivot into a commercial, "business-side" role where you can apply HKRBC or IFRS 17 knowledge to drive ROI.

The Common Denominator:

The Storyteller: You don’t just report what happened; you explain why it happened and what we should do next.

Tech-Fluent: You are comfortable with modern data stacks and eager to use technology to automate the mundane.

Agile Mindset: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where the "right answer" might change as the market evolves.

Why Join Bowtie?

The chance to shape the future of insurance in Hong Kong.

A flat, transparent culture where your ideas reach the Co-Founders, not a middle-manager's inbox.

Flexible working environment and the tools you need to innovate.

We Offer

Apart from a great career path and an opportunity to do good and do well, we also offer:

Competitive package

Flexible work arrangement

Benefits include medical/ dental coverage and wellness programs

Employee discounts

Fun, co-operative, and flexible startup culture

Weekly sharing sessions and regular social gatherings

Excellent learning opportunities with Professional Development Sponsorship

We are the first licensed virtual insurer (虛擬保險公司) in Hong Kong.


We believe that insurance is fundamentally good, and we are here to bring the good back through our passionate, innovative, and customer-centric team.


By combining our deep domain expertise and our own proprietary modern technology, we are building one of the most iconic, category-defining health insurance companies in Asia.

We take pride in moving fast all the time and our track record in moving ahead in the game. Our digital insurance platform is also ranked #2 in the world in Sia Partners' 2023 report.
